workflow: Test whether channel effects transport to neuronal firing in WWOX as predicted in the brivaracetam dossier.
evidence_basis: Results, adult CA1 pyramidal neurons: “from a membrane potential held at −60 mV”. The study tested one hour of BRV at 100 μM against the induced firing response.
